en.headline: Yellow work heat stress warning in force from late morning
en.dek: The Labour Department issued the yellow warning at 11:20 am, advising employers to take heat precautions for outdoor and non-air-conditioned indoor work.
body: The Labour Department issued a yellow work heat stress warning at 11:20 am on Monday, indicating that heat stress in some working environments is rather high.

Employers are advised to follow the department’s Guide on Preventing Heat Stroke at Work and, so far as reasonably practicable, rearrange work schedules, provide rest breaks, shade and ventilation, and ensure workers can drink water regularly.

Employees who develop symptoms such as headache, dizziness, thirst or nausea should move to a cooler place, rest and drink water, and inform their supervisor. The warning is updated hourly while it remains in force.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告上午11時20分生效
zh.dek: 勞工處表示部分工作環境熱壓力頗高，僱主應採取防暑措施，包括重新編排工作及提供適當休息。
body: 勞工處今日上午11時20分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。
僱主應參照《預防工作時中暑指引》，在合理地切實可行情況下採取防暑措施，包括重新編排工作時段、提供遮蔭、通風及適當休息時間，並提醒員工適時補充水分。
僱員如出現頭痛、頭暈、口渴或噁心等熱疾病症狀，應立即到陰涼處休息和飲水，並通知僱主或主管。警告生效期間會每小時更新。
